learning_outcomes.text: Argue for the choice of a steel construction for a given building, based on the properties of steel and the environmental impacts associated with the creation of metal structures (material production, construction phase impacts, and end-of-life treatment).
Size an element subject to tension/compression or shear and/or bending according to Eurocode 3.
Use numerical simulation tools for structural analysis and optimization of steel structures.
Understand the properties of steel, have an awareness of its environmental impact, and argue for the choice of a steel construction for a given building.
Analyze the behavior of a simple steel structure.
Produce digital plans for metal constructions.
Design and size a simple steel structure using ROBOT Structural Analysis Professional software.
Verify the sizing according to Eurocode 3 for an element subjected to tension/compression, shear, and/or bending.
Size an element according to Eurocode 3 for tension/compression, shear, and/or bending.

syllabus_topics: Advantages and limitations of this construction solution
Influence of local buckling on section strength
Classification of webs under combined bending
Verification flowchart for bending and shear
Introduction to Robot Structural Analysis Professional
Modeling, sizing, and optimization of simple frames
Application exercises on Robot Structural Analysis Professional
Application exercises on Robot Structural Analysis Professional
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (0.6 * CC1) + (0.4 * TP).
bibliography: J.-P. Muzeau, La construction métallique avec les eurocodes : interprétation et exemples de calcul. in Eurocode. Paris La Plaine Saint Denis: Eyrolles AFNOR éd, 2013.
J.-P. Muzeau, Manuel de construction métallique : extraits des Eurocodes 0, 1 et 3, 2e éd. revue et Complétée. in Collection Eurocodes. Paris La Plaine-Saint-Denis : Eyrolles AFNOR éd, 2013.
